business_problem: The development nonprofit CARE works around the world to fight poverty and promote equality, including by responding to crises. It is using AI to better understand emergency preparedness in its country offices so it can act without delay when lives are on the line.
solution_summary: The development nonprofit CARE works around the world to fight poverty and promote equality, including by responding to crises. It is using AI to better understand emergency preparedness in its country offices so it can act without delay when lives are on the line. While many emergencies cannot be foreseen, CARE strives to prepare for crises so staff in the field can react immediately. A quick response can lessen the human impact of a flood or armed conflict-and can save thousands of lives. To deepen its understanding of its emergency preparedness in high-risk countries, CARE teamed up with Microsoft Tech for Social Impact and Microsoft partner Valorem Reply. "We have been blessed to have Microsoft as a partner," says Cherian Varghese, Director of Data Science and Analytics at CARE.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs the large-language-model features for classification, summarization, retrieval, or conversational responses in the solution.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Services
solution_components.role: Supplies pretrained AI capabilities such as vision, language, or speech inside the business workflow.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Publishes dashboards and reports so teams can monitor operations and act on live insights.

data_flow: Operational and business data is gathered from the customer's source systems and published to teams through Power BI dashboards.
